items.description: Likouala-aux-Herbes is a river and wetland landscape in northern Congo. It is known for slow water, swamp forest, and bird habitat.
Mayombe Forest is a dense tropical forest in south-western Congo. It forms part of the wider Congo Basin forest belt.
The Atlantic Ocean shapes Congo's western coast and port access. It also influences the country's coastal climate and marine life.
Lake Cayo is a small lake in south-western Congo. It belongs to the coastal landscape of the Kouilou region.
The Batéké Plateaus are a broad savanna plateau region in central Congo. Their open grasslands stand in contrast to the country's forested lowlands.
The Mpoulou River is a small river in southern Congo. It supports local drainage and rural landscapes along its course.
The Ibenga River flows through the forested north of Congo. It is part of the river network that shapes the country's inland ecosystems.
